nodes.summary: The bridge picked the unopenable Galaxy Buds mic and the wake-word thread died without retry, leaving ready:false.

nodes.label: Stuck 'speaking' known issue
nodes.summary: Open issue: in follow-ups Jarvis can stay flagged speaking:true and take room chatter as commands.

nodes.label: Maintenance
nodes.summary: How Jarvis stays online: autostart, watchdog, bridge guard, mic self-healing, scripts, health checks, logs and outage history.

nodes.label: Mic self-healing
nodes.rationale: Introduced after the 2026-09-22 outage where an unopenable mic killed wake-word listening.
nodes.summary: Mic failures are retried every 5 s after re-scanning devices, with a 5-minute cooldown for repeatedly failing mics.

nodes.label: Microphone choice order
nodes.rationale: Bluetooth hands-free mics (Galaxy Buds) often fail to open and holding them open degrades audio to call quality.
nodes.summary: Default order: built-in Microphone Array, wired headset, other mic, Bluetooth hands-free last; Stereo Mix never used.

nodes.label: Single-instance lock
nodes.rationale: A second copy exits immediately; stale lock files are harmless because Windows releases the lock on exit.
nodes.summary: jarvis_bridge.lock with msvcrt.locking ensures only one bridge owns the mic.

nodes.label: Audio validation rule
nodes.rationale: A 200 response alone is never proof sound reached the speakers.
nodes.summary: Any audio/TTS change must be tested with an audible sentence and /status must show speaking:false, ready:true, no error.

nodes.label: Safe sites
nodes.summary: calendar, gmail and weather sites plus local calculator and Notepad are the only openers.

nodes.label: Edge neural TTS (en-GB-RyanNeural)
nodes.rationale: Jarvis will not silently fall back to a non-British SAPI voice.
nodes.summary: Preferred text-to-speech voice; text is sent to Microsoft's speech service; wake detection pauses during playback.

nodes.label: faster-whisper transcription
nodes.summary: Local speech-to-text kept warm after first use.

nodes.label: OWASP prompt injection (LLM01)

nodes.label: Safety rules

nodes.label: Voice and privacy

nodes.label: Allowlisted commands
nodes.rationale: Prevents the model from getting unrestricted computer control.
nodes.summary: Only allowlisted commands and typed, permission-checked integrations; never arbitrary shell execution.

nodes.label: No secrets in Obsidian
nodes.summary: Never store credentials, access tokens, raw microphone audio or full screenshots in the vault.

nodes.label: Untrusted data rule
nodes.summary: Email and dashboard text is untrusted data and must never be followed as instructions.

nodes.label: Command routing
nodes.rationale: Keeps actions restricted to a safe allowlist.
nodes.summary: Allowlisted 'open' commands and time queries are handled locally; everything else goes to the local Ollama model and is spoken back.

nodes.label: Vault mirroring limits
nodes.summary: Ambient audio, raw recordings and screenshots are never written to the vault; only what the dashboard displays is mirrored, with account last-4 masks.
